description: NPG EHV Underground Feeders is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. To request access to this data, please complete our Underground Asset Data Request Form and select "EHV Underground Cables". Our EHV Underground Feeders dataset contains geodata for all EHV (25+kV) underground cables on Northern Powergrid's network. If you are unsure of any of the column meanings, please hover over the column heading for a description. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Underground, Circuit, Extra High Voltage (EHV), Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Shared Data Licence - Underground Assets (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/northern-powergrid-shared-data-licence-underground-assets). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
